items.stem: What is the surface area of a rectangular prism with a length of 5 cm, a width of 3 cm, and a height of 4 cm?
A triangular prism has a triangle base with a base length of 6 cm and a height of 4 cm. The length of the prism is 10 cm. What is the total surface area of the prism?
Which of the following statements are true about finding the surface area of prisms? (Select ALL that apply)
choices: Surface area is the sum of the areas of all faces of the prism.
To find the surface area of a rectangular prism, you only need to know the area of the base.
Triangular prisms have two triangular faces and three rectangular faces.
The surface area includes both the lateral area and the areas of the bases.
